The <b>{{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> can be built in the [[church]] to improve your {{Church Rating}}, and to earn {{item|faith}} and a {{item|story||animation}} from parishioners who want to confess their sins there.

'''Note:''' Independent of the size of the church, there are always two possible spots to build {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}s.

==Accepting Confessions==
The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} will sometimes show a prayer icon [[File:Pray icon.png|The prayer icon shows, that the confessional is occupied|link={{PAGENAME}}]] above it, which indicates that there is someone waiting inside to confess. This can happen on any day. Just stand near the {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} and hit "E" to receive the {{item|faith|1}} and the {{item|story||animation}} and to clear the {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} for a new parishioner.

[[Faith]] is important for [[study table|research]], making some [[The_Graveyard#Tombstones|grave decorations]], [[Resurrection table|resurrecting]] zombies, crafting [[prayer]]s, inventing [[story|stories]], to advance some [[quests]], and improving some [[hard cover|book covers]].

[[Story|Stories]] are important as a basic resource for [[Book Writing (Tech Tree)|book writing]], which lead to more elaborate written works, that can then made into [[prayer]]s, sold to the [[astrologer]], or broken down on the [[study table]] for {{item|science}}.
